item.title: GTA 6 Is Not the End of Video Games
item.description: Look, the analogy doesn't really work, but that's kind of my point. A certain kind of doomsayer has presented GTA 6 as, metaphorically, the Last Video Game, an extinction-level event, a monumentally excessive fiddle solo performed by Nero amid a burning Rome. The business and culture of blockbuster AAA video games is unsustainable and visibly dying, goes the thinking, just as the ultimate exemplar of that kind of production is released. Beyond that, the entire industry is facing a series of existential threats, including both the generative AI boom and the shortage of affordable computer chips caused by the generative AI boom.

item.title: Sunrise On the Reaping Will Be the Last Hunger Games Movie if There Are No More Books
item.description: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping premieres this week, the latest installment in The Hunger Games series. It is an adaptation of Suzanne Collins' book of the same name, and tells the story of Haymitch Abernathy in the second Quarter Quell — particularly difficult games with a special twist. The book was published in March 2025, but even before it hit the shelves, Lionsgate had already greenlit an adaptation.

item.title: 20 Years Later, the PS3’s Biggest Failures Look Like Its Best Ideas
item.description: It’s fascinating now to think what a total gamble the PS3 was at the time of its release. Even after all these years, there’s no doubt in my mind it’s one of the greatest (and craziest) inventions the video game industry ever came up with. Nowadays, it’s lauded as the most ridiculous, expensive, and over-engineered console ever made. Yet when looking back at Sony circa 2001, just months after the PS2 launched and began its march to becoming the best-selling console of all time (a feat it still holds today), what was Sony supposed to do to top that? Make the PlayStation 3 do literally everything.

item.title: 19 Years Later, Tim Burton's Most Gruesome Thriller Is Officially Back on Streaming
item.description: The macabre has been Tim Burton’s playground of choice since the director’s 1982 short stop-motion film Vincent — a film full of the creepy atmosphere that would go on to define Burton in films like The Nightmare Before Christmas and Corpse Bride .

item.title: 30 Years Later, One of the Greatest ‘X-Files’ Episodes is Still a Misunderstood Masterpiece
item.description: For the first three seasons of The X-Files , the writers kept you guessing, not only with regard to the show’s greater mysteries about aliens, but also about its most intriguing character. The Cigarette Smoking Man , played by William B. Davis, begins the series as a shadowy, silent character in the first episode. He looks on as Agent Dana Scully (Gillian Anderson) is given her not-too-subtle orders to undermine Agent Fox Mulder (David Duchovny) and his work on the X-Files. He goes on to appear sparingly, just a few times each season, to stop Mulder and Scully from getting too close to the secrets he’s spent decades covering up.

item.title: GTA 6 release time in your time zone
item.description: After a long, long wait, the Grand Theft Auto 6 release time is almost here. This is a game that, for the longest time, felt like just a distant dream. It's on track to be the biggest video game of all time, and if you want to jump in as soon as possible, you need to know exactly what time it will be released.

item.title: How to play GTA 6 early using the 'New Zealand trick'
item.description: The Grand Theft Auto 6 " New Zealand trick" is a popular method players are using to play the world's most anticipated game a little early, but you need to know exactly what to do. It involves changing the time and date on your console to New Zealand's time zone, as it means as soon as the GTA 6 release time comes around over there, aka at midnight, you'll be able to play. However, there are a couple of caveats that come with it.

item.title: 'Avengers: Doomsday' Star Says He Was Lied to About His Next Big Role
item.description: Anthony Mackie’s Sam Wilson/Captain America will be leading the Avengers in Avengers: Doomsday , guiding Thor (Chris Hemsworth), Ant-Man (Paul Rudd), Shang-Chi (Simu Liu), and Falcon (Danny Ramirez) in the fight against Doctor Doom . But while Sam is getting a big promotion, Mackie said he was lied to about his next starring role.

item.title: Anne Hathaway's 100-Minute Sci-Fi Thriller Takes Over Streaming After HBO Max Debut
item.description: Anne Hathaway has had a particularly busy year, with major projects including Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey , the psychological thriller Verity , and the highly anticipated The Devil Wears Prada 2 . She's also ventured into more unconventional territory with A24's Mother Mary , a thriller that takes a considerably stranger approach to the world of pop stardom.
